info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law (Professional Law)

description.describe_ch: 開設對象為法律專業組學生。課程將討論不同國家的法律體系及司法管轄，同時要求學生必須使用外文法學資料庫，閱讀英文法學資料，並配合指定作業及課堂討論及報告，以補充學生英美法學知識，並強化其語言能力。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed for post-graduate law student. This course will dicsuss different legal systems and jurisdictions over the world. Students will be required to use on-line computer research databases and read English law journals, legislation and cases, as well as write the assignments and term paper to improve their language ability along with knowledge relating to Anglo-American law.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生了解法律英文對於法律專業之重要性，提升學生對法學英文之學習興趣。
targets.describe_en: Arouse students’ learning interest by emphasis the importance of English ability in legal profession.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生熟悉英美法之法律體系與結構。
targets.describe_en: Understand the system and structure of Anglo-American legal system.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生正確引用法律文獻之專業法學英文能力。
targets.describe_en: Develop students' professional legal English ability in understanding and citing legal documentation.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生具備使用外文資料庫(Lexis和Westlaw)查閱英美法相關法令、判決和文獻之能力。
targets.describe_en: Learn to use on-line computer research databases (Lexis and Westlaw) for legislations, case laws, various categories of legal documents and academic papers.
